4,176 likes, 20 comments - delish on October 28, 2026: "I mean, if this doesn’t win the costume contest, then I don’t know what will.

@tiffanithiessen joins SNACKS! to talk about the food memories that shaped her—from her grandmother’s baked beans and spicy applesauce with Red Hots to her go-to cucumber, feta, and dill snack.

The Saved by the Bell and Beverly Hills, 90210 star also reveals what craft services was really like on set, shares her best leftover food hacks, defends cold meatloaf, discusses her new Disney series Coven Academy, and explains why every good girls’ night needs homemade pasta, charcuterie, wine, or an extra-dirty martini.

Click the link in our bio to watch now—stream SNACKS! on Apple, Spotify, and YouTube!".

350 likes, 6 comments - delish on October 26, 2026: "You'll never want to try another pasta after @lisavanderpump's Shrimp Pasta 🍤

Lisa Vanderpump—restaurateur, entrepreneur, The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills icon, and star of Vanderpump Rules—joins Cooking With Friends to make her famous Shrimp Pasta from her cookbook, Home at Villa Rosa. She shares the story behind the recipe, why it’s one of her husband Ken Todd’s favorites, and what it’s like cooking and entertaining at Villa Rosa.

Watch the full video at the link in bio.".

posts.meta_description:
83 likes, 1 comments - delish on October 29, 2026: "@mentos.usa you are simply irresistible. 

@amberruffin takes a hilarious trip through her food memories on Déjà Food. She reveals why she carries a fanny pack full of candy, recalls eating four chocolate chip cookies for lunch in high school, shares her favorite Hema hot dog from Amsterdam, and explains how a giant trash bag of cotton candy became one of her happiest food memories.

The comedian and host also talks about The Amber Ruffin Show, her Broadway debut in Some Like It Hot, dining with Roy Wood Jr. and Michael Ian Black, pickled cheese, Rosa Mexicano’s unforgettable ribs, and the foods that shaped her life and career.

Click the link in our bio to watch now!".
